text: ひやけ　して　きちゃった…

structure.jp: ひやけ　して　きちゃった…
structure.en: I've gone and started getting sunburnt...

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: てくる after a verb says a change has been coming on up to now. ひやけ　して　きた = 'I've been getting sunburnt'.

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: ちゃった is the casual short form of てしまった, which says something happened and you regret it. ひやけ　して　きちゃった = 'I've gone and got sunburnt'.
